title: Absolute urine concentration discordance did not establish robust added nocturia prediction
abstract: Absolute standardized spot-urine osmolality–creatinine discordance did not establish incremental cross-cycle nocturia prediction beyond flexible concentration, renal/glycemic and demographic predictors: weighted Brier reduction 0.00005382, two-sample preprocessing-and-coefficient-refit PSU-bootstrap95% interval [-0.00052616, 0.00028828].
